title: Sindhu, Lakshya Sen Lead Indian Challenge at Hylo Open 2026
indian_angle: PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen are leading the Indian contingent, making it a key event for Indian fans to follow their top players.
summary: India's top shuttlers PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen are set to compete at the Hylo Open 2026 in Germany, a $500,000 prize money event running from October 27 to November 1.

title: PV Sindhu Finishes Runner-Up at French Open 2026
indian_angle: India's star shuttler PV Sindhu reached the final of the French Open 2026, marking her best-ever performance at the tournament despite a loss to World No.1 An Se Young.
summary: PV Sindhu put up a valiant fight in the French Open 2026 final but ultimately fell to World No.1 An Se Young, securing a runner-up finish which is her best result at the event.

title: BAI Releases Minutes of Junior Selection Committee Meeting
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has published the minutes from its Junior Selection Committee meeting, detailing important decisions for aspiring young Indian shuttlers.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the minutes of its Junior Selection Committee meeting held on October 19, 2026, outlining key decisions regarding junior player selections and development.

title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has established a new Athletes Committee, providing Indian players with a formal platform for representation and input into the sport's governance.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) officially announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026, aiming to give players a stronger voice in the sport's administration.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships 2026 Begins
indian_angle: India's junior badminton squad has commenced a national coaching camp at NCE, Guwahati, in preparation for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has started at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing India's young talents for the global event.
